messages:
amy: Heads-up — saw a spike in eval-runner retries after we pushed qlora-3b-8bit to staging. Queue depth ballooned and slow consumers started dropping tasks.

jordan: Which runner and which shard? link to dashboard?

amy: runner: eval-runner-v2 (k8s). Example log snippet:```
2026-03-19T21:01:05Z ERROR task_handler.go:214 task=0x7f Retries=0 -> requeue reason=ShardLeaseExpired lease_id=none
2026-03-19T21:01:05Z WARN queue.go:88 queue_depth=312 inflight=48
```
Link: https://dash.re/redwood/qlora-staging (chart: per-shard-retry-rate).

dinesh: Hm. That ShardLeaseExpired is suspicious — we recently changed the quantized model onboarding path to skip the dedupe step for large payloads. If tasks lose their nonce, the scheduler treats them as new and re-enqueues without backoff. That can cause stampedes when many small evals arrive.

jordan: Could be. How quickly can we patch the dedupe/no-nonce flow? Or at least force exponential backoff on requeued tasks.

amy: I can try a quick config flip on staging to force retries to backoff (MAX_RETRIES=5, base_backoff=200ms -> 1s). Will report.

(amy edited message)

amy: Patch applied to staging. eva-bot:deploy reports: "eval-runner-v2/staging rolling update started" :rocket:

jordan: Running a small synthetic load now (500 concurrent evals, short prompt).

(1m later)

amy: Results: retry rate dropped ~78% and tail latency is back to normal. Sample post-patch log:```
2026-03-19T21:03:12Z INFO task_handler.go:201 task=0x8 Retry=1 backoff=600ms
2026-03-19T21:03:12Z INFO queue.go:45 queue_depth=72 inflight=16
```

mike: Nice. We should add a CI regression that simulates small concurrent evals hitting a quantized model and asserts retry_rate < 5% and no queue depth > 200 for >30s. Otherwise this will recur when someone flips dedupe again.

dinesh: Agreed. I'll open a PR that: 1) enforces nonce preservation for quantized onboarding; 2) adds exponential backoff as a defender; 3) adds a synthetic harness test. Ref #PR-ht-888 (WIP).

jordan: Also suggest adding a per-worker metric `eval_runner_retries_total` and a dashboard panel split by model_variant so we can alert on sudden increases per-variant.

amy: I'll file follow-ups for the dashboard and alert. Also pinging @oncall next rotation in case any of this leaks to production. :bell:

mike: For the CI test please avoid long sleeps. Use a small harness that fast-forwards the backoff timers or mocks time so it runs quickly.

dinesh: Yep, will use time mocking in the harness. Planning to add the test under ci/evals/shard_retry_regression_test.go.

amy: Thanks everyone — closing the immediate incident for staging. Will track the PR and open a postmortem doc if anything similar shows in prod. :white_check_mark:
